units: I Kings VI, 29; preced., cmp. ἐνώπια) [that which is in front of you when you enter,] inside, interior; לִפְנַי (וְ)לִפְ׳ the innermost. Tosef. Yom. II, 5 היו מסיקין מבחוץ והיה נאפה ונרדה מבפ׳ they heated the oven towards the outside (placed the fuel in front), and it (the show-bread) was baked and shoveled out from the interior; Yoma 38ᵃ, v. נָסַק.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 16a:19">B. Mets. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>זו אינה צריכה לפ׳</he> this (question) need not be brought inside (the college); <he>צריכה לפ׳ ולפני לפ׳</he> it must be brought inside and even to the innermost.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:8">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>יכנס … לפ׳</he> let R. Ḥ. the elder go into the interior (to the front benches); <he>לפ׳ ממני</he> in front of me?; <he>ר׳ … לפ׳ ור׳ ישמעאל … לפני לפ׳</he> R. Ḥ. … to the interior, R. I. … to the innermost (the very first); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3:8">Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>לפני ולפ׳</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 6:4:4">Y. Yeb. VI, 7ᶜ</cite> <he>אחותו לעולם היא</he> (<he>מִ</he>)<he>בִּפְ׳ וכ׳</he> a priest’s sister is always inside (a member of the priestly family), until she steps outside (by marriage).
Sabb. I, 1; a. v. fr.—לפ׳ משורת הדין, v. דִּין II.—Esp. the Temple precincts, the Temple and the priests’ court; לפני ולפ׳ the innermost, Holy of Holies.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 50a:11">Ab. Zar. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>בעינא כעין פ׳</he> (for a gift to an idol to be permanently forbidden for use, even after cancellation,) it is required that it be like the offerings in the interior Temple (sacrifices, incense &c., to the exclusion of votive gifts like candles, jewels &c.).
<cite ref="Menachot 9a:5">Men. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>לא בעיא בפ׳</he> must not necessarily be done within the Temple precincts, opp. to <he>חוץ לחומת העזרה</he>.
<cite ref="Menachot 9a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>נהי … פ׳ מיהת בעיא</he> although it may be done by a non-priest, it must at least be done within &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 5:1:7">Y. Yoma V, 42ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>כלפי לפ׳</he> towards the interior; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 5:1:7">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 8:4:5">Y. Kil. VIII, 31ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>מהו מבפ׳</he> (<cite ref="M00347"><he>מהו</he></cite>) <he>מבחוץ</he> does it belong inside (to the Holy of Holies) or outside (to the Holy)?, v. <cite ref="I00904"><he>טְרַקְסִין</he></cite>.
